title: Advanced tool use (Anthropic engineering)
one-line finding: Tool search: ~55K->~8.7K tokens; internal MCP eval Opus4 49->74%, Opus4.5 79.5->88.1%; says tool search does not break caching
key limitation: internal benchmark unnamed; token not bill; no variance

title: Tool search tool docs
one-line finding: All defs still sent every request; deferred excluded from prefix; selection degrades >30-50 tools; keep 3-5 non-deferred; <10 tools not worth it; default 5 results; BM25/regex
key limitation: claims, not measured; BM25/regex lexical

title: Tool use with prompt caching
one-line finding: Modifying tool defs invalidates entire cache; deferred discovery appended as tool_reference keeps prefix
key limitation: docs not live-verified

title: Mid-conversation system messages / tool changes
one-line finding: tool_addition/tool_removal blocks change offered tools without editing tools array; cache still hits; by-value first tool when no non-deferred tool costs one miss
key limitation: beta; Anthropic models only; not available on Sonnet 5; not live-verified

title: OpenAI Tool search guide
one-line finding: Designed to preserve cache; discovered tools injected at end of context; changing loaded tool set breaks cache from that point; namespaces <10 functions; only gpt-5.4+; compare completion/tokens/latency before default
key limitation: no numbers; gpt-5.4+ only (not our models)

title: RAG-MCP 2505.03275
one-line finding: Retrieval top-k: selection acc 43.1% vs 13.6% all tools; prompt tokens ~1084 vs ~2134
key limitation: own synthetic MCP stress test; tokens not bill; no cache

title: ToolRet 2503.01763
one-line finding: Best retriever nDCG@10 33.8 on 43k-tool corpus; low retrieval quality degrades pass rate
key limitation: retrieval-only focus; static queries

title: LiveMCPBench 2508.01780
one-line finding: Retrieve+execute ReAct over 527 tools: retrieval errors 50% of failures; k=1 64.2% vs k=5 78.95% (p=0.02), k=10 no gain; Sonnet4 6.07M tokens/task
key limitation: no cost/caching; no all-tools arm; LLM-judge evaluator

title: How Many Tools Should an LLM Agent See? 2605.24660
one-line finding: Adaptive K matches fixed K=50 coverage at K~7 on BFCL/BM25; fixed K=5 beats on embeddings and ToolBench aggregate; weak scorer leads to K~80; downstream choice 93.1% (K~2.2) vs 87.1% (K=5) but end-to-end 71.7 vs 73.3
key limitation: small RL agents; single seed on MetaTool; no cost/caching

title: ToolChoiceConfusion 2606.06284
one-line finding: Synthetic 100 tools: all tools 0.83 success/24.6k tok; keyword top-5 0.61/4.4k tok, more wrong calls; causal minimal filter 0.99/2.4k
key limitation: synthetic, mocked tools, 4 models; tokens not cost; no cache

title: Don't Break the Cache 2601.06007
one-line finding: Caching cuts agentic cost 41-80% (DeepResearch Bench, 4 models); states dynamic tool sets invalidate prefix (assertion, no tool-set-change experiment); full-context caching may add write overhead
key limitation: one benchmark; tool-set change not measured; write cost not measured

title: Vanta: cache miss that made our agent faster
one-line finding: 280+ tools/75k tokens; core tools + domain-expansion tool, set stable after expansion; cache-hit rate dropped but cost/run -48%, completion +5% relative, latency -8/10/15%
key limitation: self-reported, no CI, no baseline detail; production not benchmark

title: Slite: progressive tool loading
one-line finding: 17 tools upfront/65+ on demand in tree; 63-question benchmark: cost/question -23%, latency -12%; no accuracy figure
key limitation: self-reported; no accuracy; no cache numbers

title: TheMCPCompany 2510.19286
one-line finding: 18k Azure tools; retrieval agents beat browser agents (+5.4 pts, -$2.06/task); ground-truth tools +13.8, -$2.29; smaller models cannot exploit retrieval
key limitation: secondhand numbers; different comparison (tools vs browser)

title: MCP-Universe 2508.14704
one-line finding: Long-context and unknown-tools challenges noted; token input grows with steps
key limitation: no controlled tool-count experiment confirmed

title: Tool Attention 2604.21816
one-line finding: Lazy schema loading 47.3k->2.4k tokens/turn in simulated 120-tool setup; success/cost PROJECTED, not measured; cache not measured
key limitation: simulation; explicitly not live agents

title: Enrich-Retrieve-Rank 2608.22695
one-line finding: In-context routing Match@1 0.85->0.12 as N 10->7278; retrieve-rank 0.81->0.39; crossover ~N=500 (Nova Micro); ~70x lower cost than full-context
key limitation: capability routing (agents/tools/skills), not ReAct exposure; cost = tokens

title: MCP tool description smells 2602.14878
one-line finding: 856 tools/103 servers: 97.1% have a smell; augmentation +5.85 pp median success but +67% steps; 16.7% of cases worse
key limitation: FM-based scanner; modest effect

title: SING 2606.16591
one-line finding: Active (multi-step) discovery beats one-shot retrieval: up to +59.8% recall@5, +28.9% success, -99.8% schema exposure (max gains)
key limitation: benchmarks unnamed; no cost; max not mean

title: Less is More 2411.15399
one-line finding: Llama3.1-8B fails with 46 tools, succeeds with 19 on a GeoEngine query
key limitation: single illustrative case; small model

title: ScaleMCP 2505.06416 / Toolshed 2410.14594
one-line finding: Retriever + auto-sync tool index; Toolshed RAG-tool fusion Recall@5 +41-56 pts over BM25
key limitation: not opened; recall not bill; same author group as S11

title: Hermes issue 27339 / claude-code issue 81967 / hermes 20880
one-line finding: Shuffled tool order drops cache hit ratio ~5000:1 to ~1:1; tools-array mutation rebuilds prefix; tool schemas ~70% of input bill when outside cache breakpoints
key limitation: single-user, unverified

title: Claude Code ToolSearch issue cluster
one-line finding: Deferred tools not indexed / not available first turn / regressions across versions
key limitation: bugs in one harness

title: Stacklok vs Anthropic tool search; Arcade
one-line finding: Claims 34% vs 94% selection accuracy at 2,792 tools; Arcade 56%/64% retrieval for regex/BM25 at 4,027 tools
key limitation: competitors with products

title: Bifrost/Maxim Code Mode benchmark
one-line finding: 508 tools: input tokens -92.8%, 65/65 passes both
key limitation: vendor; tokens only

title: PEToolLLM 2502.18980; PTBench 2505.04072; ETAPP 2503.00771
one-line finding: Personalised tool selection from user history is benchmarked; no cost/cache; none of these evaluate ReAct exposure bill
key limitation: not opened; ToolSpectrum not found

title: Erl 2603.24639 (ReAct cost table)
one-line finding: Claimed: baseline ReAct 82% of input tokens cached; extra context +85% input tokens but only ~+15% cost
key limitation: only seen via search summary
